headline: Year-end giving: big donors are steady, small donors are stretched
dek: The Chronicle of Philanthropy's year-end playbook, published November 24, says midlevel and major donors are giving generously while many everyday donors are pinched by gas and grocery costs. Donor-advised funds remain flush after donors gave ahead of a tax law that took effect in January, and GivingTuesday is December 1. The fundraisers it describes are bringing bigger ideas to major donors, asking younger supporters to raise money from their own networks and sending personal mail appeals.
why: A small nonprofit that depends on many small gifts could see a softer GivingTuesday, and one ask sent to the whole list may miss what each group can give.
doThis: Before December 1, test your donation form on a phone, add a way to give from a donor-advised fund, and send different GivingTuesday asks to your larger and smaller donors.
